_note: DRAFT skills for owner review. Generated from the undone T208 build (design/skills-board/undone-build-handoffs). Not game data.

nodes.name: Space Storage
nodes.plain: Lets you keep one large company storage per system, the Space Storage. Planet storage feeds it slowly.
nodes.flavour: One great hold in the sky, held in common, quietly kept by you.

nodes.name: Permit Charter
nodes.plain: Lets you buy permits for new systems and run routes between systems.
nodes.flavour: No ship leaves the home sky without a charter. This is the charter.

nodes.name: Prospecting
nodes.plain: Lets routes start at asteroid clusters and shows how much each cluster holds.
nodes.flavour: The Commons owns every rock. It has not counted the ones nobody has looked at.

nodes.name: Drydock Deals
nodes.plain: Cuts Ship upkeep by 20%. Unlocks Military crafting in your second system.
nodes.flavour: Every machine is a slow bill with wings. Cut the bill.

nodes.name: Double Casting
nodes.plain: Military workshops make one more batch a cycle, if you haul the inputs. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Same furnace, twice the pour. The Plan calls it thrift.

nodes.name: Debris Pilots
nodes.plain: Routes with Military goods carry 12.5% more a cycle and ignore debris events on the lane.
nodes.flavour: A good pilot reads the rubble like a timetable.

nodes.name: Hull Works
nodes.plain: Unlocks a second Military product. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Shell a hull well and the quarrel goes elsewhere.

nodes.name: Embargo Desk
nodes.plain: Every {m} cycles pick a rival: its Military strength falls by half for {n} cycles.
nodes.flavour: A polite desk with a very long reach.

nodes.name: Contract Doctrine
nodes.plain: Events that cut your Military prices hit half as hard. Military sales pay 6% more. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Write the terms first. The sky respects a clause.

nodes.name: Standing Fleet
nodes.plain: Cuts all rivals' Military growth in half for the rest of the run. Capstone.
nodes.flavour: A fleet that is always there needs no speech.

nodes.name: Price Whisper
nodes.plain: Shows next cycle's prices. Unlocks Luxury crafting.
nodes.flavour: Prices move before people do. Listen to the walls.

nodes.name: Fine Finishing
nodes.plain: Luxury sales count 8% more toward share and pay 6% more. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: A good edge earns a second look. A third earns a price.

nodes.name: Event Forecast
nodes.plain: Warns you one cycle before an event, in all four markets.
nodes.flavour: The sky has moods. The Plan pretends not to notice them.

nodes.name: Cold Cellar
nodes.plain: Unlocks a second Luxury product, made only from second-system goods. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Some things improve in the dark. So do some excuses.

nodes.name: Patron's List
nodes.plain: Sales at a price-up planet count 30% more toward your Luxury share, and the event pays 25% more.
nodes.flavour: The right name on the right list is worth a ship.

nodes.name: Long Ledger
nodes.plain: Prices and events are shown 2 cycles ahead.
nodes.flavour: The Ledger keeps a page for tomorrow's tomorrow. Nobody asks who writes it.

nodes.name: Hallmark
nodes.plain: Each Luxury batch yields one more unit. Luxury sales pay 8% more. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: One more piece from every pour. The mould was always big enough.

nodes.name: Guild Seal
nodes.plain: Every {m} cycles pick a rival: its Luxury strength falls by 40% for {n} cycles. Capstone.
nodes.flavour: Buy the client, not the goods. The guild keeps a form for it.

nodes.name: Fabrication Licence
nodes.plain: Unlocks Minerals crafting. Needs Prospecting.
nodes.flavour: A licence to make one good thing from two bad rocks. Stamped in triplicate.

nodes.name: Smelting
nodes.plain: Orders for mined cargo ignore the size cap. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Heat is honest. It only asks what you put in.

nodes.name: Cold Survey
nodes.plain: Lets routes start at Cinderrest and mine its salt. Cluster yield up 25%. Dead worlds open later.
nodes.flavour: A rock no one lives on still has a ledger line. Someone must read it.

nodes.name: Twin Crucible
nodes.plain: Minerals workshops make one more batch a cycle. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Two metals agree if you hold them hot enough.

nodes.name: Deep Cut
nodes.plain: Lets routes start at Greywake and mine its humming glass. Needs Cold Survey.
nodes.flavour: Under the dust lies glass that hums. The Bureau has no form for it yet.

nodes.name: Hard Hats
nodes.plain: Minerals routes carry 10% more and ignore debris. Minerals price events hit 30% weaker.
nodes.flavour: Hard hats do not stop a rock. They stop the crew worrying. The Plan counts both.

nodes.name: Lattice Works
nodes.plain: Each Minerals batch yields one more unit and sales pay 8% more. Unlocks a further product. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: A good lattice forgives the one who made it.

nodes.name: Cornered Seam
nodes.plain: Cuts all rivals' Minerals strength by 30% for the rest of the run. Capstone.
nodes.flavour: The last seam in reach belongs to someone. Now it is you.

nodes.name: Culture Charter
nodes.plain: Unlocks Biotech crafting in your second system.
nodes.flavour: A good form is one you only file once. The Bureau will not mind.

nodes.name: Culture Banks
nodes.plain: Stored Biotech grows 2% a cycle, up to +20%. Biotech sales count 12% more toward share. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Something grows in the dark and asks for nothing. For now.

nodes.name: Deep Shelves
nodes.plain: Planet storage holds 50% more. Biotech stock may now grow up to +30% before it stops.
nodes.flavour: A shelf is a promise that something will be there.

nodes.name: Gene Splicing
nodes.plain: Unlocks the last Biotech product. Biotech sales pay 10% more. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: A small cut, a small stitch. The vat hums approval.

nodes.name: Clinic Contracts
nodes.plain: Biotech share counts 12 more cycles, so it moves steadily. Biotech stock survives storage cuts.
nodes.flavour: A clinic pays slowly, which the Bureau calls trust.

nodes.name: Hardy Strains
nodes.plain: Biotech events hit 40% weaker. A closed planet reopens a cycle sooner. Sales pay 8% more. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: A strain that survives the form survives most things.

nodes.name: Patent Wall
nodes.plain: Cuts all rivals' Biotech strength by 25% for the rest of the run. Capstone.
nodes.flavour: A wall made of paper outlasts one made of stone.

nodes.name: Route Ledger
nodes.plain: Shows each route's Income after costs per cycle on its row, and marks a loss.
nodes.flavour: Every route gets a line in the Ledger. Some lines are short on good news.

nodes.name: Pathfinder
nodes.plain: Cuts the Pathfinder's flight time by 30%.
nodes.flavour: The scout learns the dark. The dark does not return the favour.

nodes.name: Lane Yards
nodes.plain: Cuts the cost of upgrading a route by 25%. Applies to route upgrades only.
nodes.flavour: A lane wears. The yard mends it and files a note with the Bureau.

nodes.name: Surplus Hulls
nodes.plain: Cuts the price of a new Skerrit by 15%. Ship upkeep does not change.
nodes.flavour: Last season's hulls at this season's price. The paint is still wet.

nodes.name: Tight Press
nodes.plain: Military sales count 5% more toward share. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Press it tight and the Plan counts it twice. Nearly.

nodes.name: Yard Kits
nodes.plain: Military output pays part of the price of a new Skerrit. Purchase only. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: A hull on the slip is a bill. Stock in the yard is a discount.

nodes.name: Open Arsenal
nodes.plain: Military share counts the last 12 cycles, not 8. Rivals use the same window.
nodes.flavour: Open the doors. Everyone sees what you hold, and so do you.

nodes.name: War Economy
nodes.plain: Each Military batch makes one more unit. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: The war is small. The economy is large. The Plan adjusts the sums.

nodes.name: Full Mobilisation
nodes.plain: Once per run, for 5 cycles: Military routes pay no upkeep and ignore route events.
nodes.flavour: Every hull, every crew, one season. The Bureau notes the date.

nodes.name: Rival Whisper
nodes.plain: Competitors shows each rival's next tier-up cycle and its projected share 3 cycles ahead.
nodes.flavour: Rivals file forms too. Someone has to read them.

nodes.name: Second Loom
nodes.plain: Luxury workshops make one more batch a cycle. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: One loom is a craft. Two is a schedule.

nodes.name: Trend Desk
nodes.plain: Events that cut Luxury prices hit about a third softer.
nodes.flavour: Read the mood early and the blow lands on a cushion.

nodes.name: Courier Pool
nodes.plain: Luxury routes carry 10% more each cycle.
nodes.flavour: News travels fastest in a crate.

nodes.name: Patron's Purse
nodes.plain: Mixed load pays more when every good sold at the planet is Luxury. The credit cap still applies.
nodes.flavour: A patron buys the whole shelf and calls it taste.

nodes.name: Auction House
nodes.plain: Luxury sales count 6% more toward share. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: The gavel falls. The Ledger notes the sum and the hush.

nodes.name: Grand Salon
nodes.plain: Cuts all rivals' Luxury growth by 15% for the rest of the run. Capstone.
nodes.flavour: A room so fine that rivals stop to admire it and fall behind.

nodes.name: Strip Mining
nodes.plain: Asteroid clusters give 25% more each cycle. The total in each cluster does not change.
nodes.flavour: Take the top layer fast. The rock was not going anywhere. Now it is.

nodes.name: Slag Reclaim
nodes.plain: Minerals workshops use one less input per batch, never fewer than one. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Nothing is wasted. It is merely reassigned.

nodes.name: Safe Passage
nodes.plain: Halves the chance of losing cargo while mining a dead world.
nodes.flavour: The dark takes its share. The Plan asks it to take less.

nodes.name: Pit-head Smelter
nodes.plain: Lets you build a Minerals workshop at a mining platform. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Why haul the rock home to be melted. It does not mind the heat.

nodes.name: Rock Brokers
nodes.plain: Events that raise Minerals prices pay 25% more.
nodes.flavour: A broker sells the same stone twice and the rumour once.

nodes.name: Mass Smelting
nodes.plain: Minerals sales count 6% more toward share. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: One furnace is a trade. A hall of them is a policy.

nodes.name: Motherlode
nodes.plain: Asteroid clusters hold 50% more before they run dry.
nodes.flavour: The Commons said the rock was nearly empty. The Commons had not looked deep.

nodes.name: Common Vats
nodes.plain: Biotech routes carry 12.5% more each cycle.
nodes.flavour: The vat belongs to everyone. The delivery belongs to you.

nodes.name: Spore Bank
nodes.plain: Biotech workshops make one more batch a cycle. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Deposit one spore. Withdraw a season. Interest accrues quietly.

nodes.name: Deep Shelf
nodes.plain: Biotech in Space Storage grows 1% a cycle, up to +10% of the stored amount.
nodes.flavour: The back shelves are cold. Whatever sleeps there keeps growing.

nodes.name: Graft Lines
nodes.plain: Each Biotech batch makes one more unit. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: Join two strains and file them as one. The form allows it.

nodes.name: Patient Orchard
nodes.plain: Stored Biotech grows 3% a cycle, not 2%, but not the cycle after a sale. The limit does not change.
nodes.flavour: Pick nothing and it ripens. Pick something and it sulks for a cycle.

nodes.name: Living Contracts
nodes.plain: Biotech sales pay 6% more. Tech: craft {goal} units.
nodes.flavour: A contract that grows with the harvest. The clauses sprout.
